coding.note: Codes cover the model family described in the report, including the explicitly experimental reasoning extension. Contribution-list performance claims are coded OTHER; reasoning enhancement is POST. Mixture-of-LoRAs has only confounded comparisons against differently trained baseline models, so its ablation is PARTIAL, not YES. No matched ablation of GQA is reported. The dynamic crop strategy and detailed reasoning-training novelty appear outside the abstract/introduction/contribution list and are not separate C1 entries. Data categories and some quantities are disclosed, but no reconstructible mixture. Comparator list is capped at 15, prioritizing multimodal results. External OpenASR leaderboard placement is reported; internal Microsoft red teams alone are not treated as external evaluation. No explicit renaming of a known technique is established.
